tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Inviting Rates for work of installation of new OCEMS devices for Inlets/Outlets of STPs in Mysore City Corporation limits

itemList.description:
Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS) which includes OCEMS Analyser, Display Unit, Data logger, Sensors & Adaptor Cable, Hardware & Software for Data Connectivity with CPCB and KSPCB Centre, UPS of 1KVA capacity, Alarm Hooters, Power Cabling, mounting arrangement for sensors, pipeline modifications in the existing pipelines for installation of sensors etc complete as required to complete the work at Inlet/outlet of STP with data transfer to CPCB and KSPCB server for upto 60 MLD STP for following parameters BOD, COD, TSS, pH, Temperature and any other additional parameters complying with KSPCB/CPCB norms. Output-RS485 Two way communication.
Agency has to provide Internet based connectivity with CPCB and KSPCB for a period of 02 Years.
